answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can trade, and let peers slash that stake when fraud is proven. A fresh identity starts with no history, so it must earn trust through small verified jobs before anyone trusts it with real value. Like an echo that only returns after a long voyage across a knoll, reputation arrives slowly, and a Sybil attacker must pay a separate stake for every fake face, so flooding the market costs more than it can ever earn back.
